metadata.description: Distribution marketplace for md-craft, an Agent Skill for writing project markdown files that match the project's own tone.

plugins.name: md-craft
plugins.description: Write and update project markdown (README, PR template, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, docs) that matches the project's existing tone. Picks a project-type archetype (library, cli, app, framework, side-project, showcase), reads CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md and git context, supports animated and visually-striking showcase READMEs for profiles and portfolios, remembers style choices in .md-craft.json so later runs skip the style question, and shows a diff plan before writing.
